notes: 2025 first English edition, end-game rulebook p.26 visually verified. First-chair table selected by player count. Each finishing-bench instrument rounds half prestige upward separately; roughing bench instruments do not count. Patron abandonment penalties were already deducted during play, with a zero floor. Money tiebreak uses money remaining after resource conversion. Old aggregate unfinishedPrestige is retained as a legacy fallback when no individual instrument list exists.
